name: POST /api/media/:blob_id/ready — sdk-media

testCases.name: Commit an uploaded blob with its SHA-256 checksum

description: Commits an upload: the client reports the SHA-256 it computed and the blob transitions to ready. Returns 200 with the updated blob. checksum_hex must be exactly 64 hex characters (an optional 0x prefix is stripped before the check). The blob's tenant is asserted against the JWT tenant_id claim, so committing another tenant's blob is a 403. Edge cases: a malformed or truncated checksum is a 400; an unknown blob_id is a 404 BlobNotFound; a blob whose bytes have already been cryptographically shredded is a 410 Gone; a blob attached to a sealed encounter is a 409; a JWT with no tenant_id claim is a 403 rather than a 401; re-posting ready for an already-ready blob is not specially guarded and simply repeats the state write.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
The token verifies but carries no tenant_id claim
Request body is absent or not a JSON object

errorCases.message: checksum_hex must be a 64-char hex SHA-256
errorCases.when: checksum_hex is missing, or is not 64 hexadecimal characters after stripping an optional 0x prefix

errorCases.message: markBlobReady: caller tenant <tid> does not own this blob
errorCases.when: The blob's tenant_id differs from the JWT tenant_id claim
No blob row exists for the supplied blob_id

errorCases.message: Encounter <encounter_id> is sealed; new evidence blocked per FR-MED-5
errorCases.when: The blob belongs to an encounter that has since been sealed
The blob key material was shredded, so the object can no longer be committed or read
Any other markBlobReady failure (storage or database error)
